rootCause: The running POS retains a credential for a Device/Venue absent from the currently selected Docker database. Device lookup fails; this is independent of hostname connectivity and entered activation code/PIN.
remainingUiBlocker: PosFirstRun treats mere local credential presence as connected and exposes only First Activation while no local Staff exist; this branch has no reconnect action. A small non-security recovery-navigation change can expose the existing enrollment form without clearing local data or credentials. It has not been implemented in this read-only diagnosis.
supportedRecovery: Platform Admin issues current Venue POS enrollment -> POS Re-enrol this POS -> Manager activation; first-run waiting branch has no reconnect access
